domainTips.title: What makes a strong domain name
intro: To stand out you need a memorable name and an easy domain. One of the best ways to do that is by choosing a meaningful web address that people can recall, type, and trust at a glance.
Here are a few hallmarks of a good domain and why they matter:
featureList: Keep it short, meaningful, and memorable so it is easy to say and share.
Make it unique, catchy, and relevant to what you do to set clear expectations.
Avoid odd spellings and complicated wording to reduce typos and confusion.
